description: This bar chart illustrates the performance of three language models – Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and RedWhale (our) – on a task labeled “QA-1”. The categories, representing the different language models, are listed vertically on the left axis, in the order Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and RedWhale (our). The horizontal axis represents the proportion of correct, partially correct, and incorrect answers, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. Each model is represented by a horizontal stacked bar, divided into three colored segments. The leftmost, blue segment represents the proportion of “Correct” answers, the middle, purple segment represents “Partially Correct” answers, and the rightmost, light gray segment represents incorrect answers. For Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B, the “Correct” segment is approximately 0.88 units long, the “Partially Correct” segment is approximately 0.08 units long, and the “Incorrect” segment is 0.04 units long. For both EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 and RedWhale (our), the “Correct” segment is approximately 0.96 units long, the “Partially Correct” segment is 0 units long, and the “Incorrect” segment is 0.04 units long. The bars are not sorted in any apparent order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
